decisions.reason: The area elastic sports flooring system builds on the firm's established sports-floor know-how and in-house production, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The mobile arena floor serves a stable project-based niche that uses existing capabilities, so keeping it costs little slack, though it overlaps with Product C.
A second mobile arena system raises some risk of consolidation with Product B, but without signs of underperformance management is likely to keep the line.
The chevron parquet is a home-page flagship that fits the firm's trend-led, natural-aesthetic direction, so it is very likely meeting or shaping aspirations.
The squash court finish is a small, low-cost niche add-on that rounds out the sports offer, and it is unlikely to draw attention unless overall performance falls short.
Oak skirting is a cheap complementary accessory that supports the sports-floor systems and ties up little in the way of resources.
